The assistant also listed Bear Lake, Dream Lake, Moraine Park, Nymph Lake, Sprague Lake, and Emerald Lake as popular Rocky Mountain National Park sunrise viewpoints, and advised checking weather conditions and road closures and arriving early.

It described Nymph Lake as offering surrounding mountain views, Emerald Lake as offering sunrise views of the mountains, and Moraine Park as accessible by car followed by a short walk to the meadow or short hikes to nearby viewpoints.
